text.description_html:
DWD-FPR1170-630, Satin Stainless Steel Swinging Door Flush Pull

Finally there is a modern-looking flush pull that can be used on swinging doors! This Satin Stainless Steel Flush Pull was designed with a 7/16 inch lip so it is easy to grab hold of. The Easy Grip Flush Pull is a nice big 6-11/16 inch x 3-1/8 inches. Use this flush pull on pocket doors, cabinets, barn doors, pretty much anywhere. The lip ensures that you will have a comfortable grip no matter what.

Features and Specifications of the Rectangular Easy Grip Stainless Steel Flush Pull:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Lip: 7/16"
  • Length: 6-11/16" (120 mm)
  • Width: 3-1/8" (80 mm)
  • Opening Length: 4-5/8" (80 mm)
  • Opening Width: 1-1/2" (40 mm)
  • Projection: 1/8" (3 mm)
  • Installation Depth: 19/32" (16 mm)
  • Installation Length: 5-1/4" (150 mm)
  • Installation Width: 2-17/32" (70 mm)
  • Solid Stainless steel construction
  • Comes packaged with (2) stainless steel installation screws

Sold Individually
